d:
When I was first starting calisthenics, I kept hearing about the importance of "consistency."
The nuance I've learned is that consistency works best with a good plan.
And finding a good plan usually involves some change (or experimenting).
If you keep changing your plan and never commit to anything, it's hard to make any substantial progress. On the other hand, if you never try anything else, you may be stuck on an exercise or plan that limits your overall potential.
